create_turn_condition_wrapper: create a wrapped condition function that pauses the environment and evaluates a trigger condition at a specific turn index
build_placeholder_mapper: build a mapping from event IDs to oracle event IDs using placeholder metadata and completed events
test_is_send_message_to_user: test if an event is a send message to user event by checking OracleEvent or CompletedEvent types
review_condition_from_name: review the condition_from_name function to reconstruct a wrapped condition from its serialized function name string
run_dummy_trigger_condition: run a dummy trigger condition that always returns true and maps placeholders to oracle event IDs
